management_steps.details: Oral, 170 mg 12 hourly with meals. Intermittent iron alternative: 340 mg per week (approx. 110 mg elemental iron) with meals.
Do not ingest with tea, antacids or calcium supplements/milk. Take on empty stomach, but take with meals if GI side effects occur.
